title: AI review outcome record v1 (one JSONL line per finding per state change)
description: Written by post.py (outcome=posted) and by a scheduled ledger job on main that reads PR state through the API (all other outcomes). Append-only; the latest record per (repo, pr, finding_id) is the current state. Stored on an orphan branch `review-ledger` as ledger/YYYY-MM.jsonl so evalkit can read it without PR code ever holding contents:write.

finding_id.description: sha256 over (repo, file, category, normalized title, enclosing symbol); stable across re-runs, used for dedup.

comment_id.description: GitHub review comment id; null when the finding was only in the summary or SARIF.

outcome.description: resolved_with_change: a later commit on the PR touched [line-3, line_end+3] of the file before merge. rejected: owner reacted -1 or replied `/ai-reject <reason>`. ignored: PR merged or closed with neither. reverted_later: merged, then a revert or fix commit within 30 days touches the same lines (candidate missed-bug signal for the classifier and the risk model). superseded: a re-run produced the same finding_id on a newer head.

fingerprint.description: Same provenance discipline as evals/swe_ab/analyze.py (target_fingerprint, code_fingerprint): never pool records across different values without saying so.

prompt_version.description: sha256 of review-system-prompt.md + REVIEW.md as sent

harness_version.description: git sha of tools/pr_review at base
